commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+1' Brest failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Martin Satriano (Brest) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that Mory Diaw expertly pushes away.
87' Brest seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
86' Yoel Armougom (Clermont) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
85' Eric Roy has decided to make a change. Martin Satriano (Brest) replaces Steve Mounie.
83' Surely that's handball by one of the Brest players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
81' Substitution. Cheick Oumar Konate makes way for Yoel Armougom (Clermont).
79' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) fires in the free kick from a promising position just outside the box. It's a fantastic strike and looks set for glory, but it only rattles the crossbar!
79' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) will take the free kick.
78' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Mathias Pereira Lage and he is replaced by Adrien Lebeau (Brest).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mahdi Camara trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jonas Martin (Brest).
76' A quickly taken corner by Brest.

76' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Now Brest have a corner.
75' Mahdi Camara (Brest) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
74' Mahdi Camara (Brest) picks up an injury.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Habib Keita (Clermont) is coming onto the pitch as Maxime Gonalons cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Pascal Gastien decides to make a substitution. Mehdi Zeffane will be replaced by Andy Pelmard (Clermont).
70' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marc Bollengier had an easy-decision to make.
69' Bradley Locko (Brest) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward.
68' Brest take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' Here is a change. Hugo Magnetti is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) comes onto the pitch so that Romain Del Castillo can be given a rest.
66' Brest are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
63' A pass into the box finds Kenny Lala (Brest) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Mory Diaw denies him.
62' Pascal Gastien has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) replacing Shamar Nicholson.
62' The referee allows time for a substitution. Elbasan Rashani will be replaced by Muhammed Cham (Clermont).
58' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
56' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
53' Clermont take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

51' 3 - 0 Goal! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Mory Diaw had no chance of reaching it. The score is 3:0.

48' What an opportunity! Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the left side of the goal, but Marco Bizot reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
48' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

47' Clermont slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
47' The linesman raises his flag. Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is adjudged offside.
46' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle after Yohan Magnin (Clermont) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Clermont couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Marco Bizot (Brest) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
45' Bradley Locko (Brest) has tested the patience of referee Marc Bollengier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
43' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) connects well with the free kick, but heads the ball just over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
43' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for an infringement.
42' Surely that's handball by one of the Brest players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
41' Wow, what an escape. Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
41' Brest showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball has crossed the sideline. Clermont are taking a throw-in.
40' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:0.
39' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
37' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
35' 2 - 0 Goal! Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 2:0.
32' Wonderful movement by Clermont. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
27' What a great touch by Kenny Lala (Brest)! He picks up a precise pass and produces a long-range shot, but his fabulous effort smashes off the right post!

26' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Brest are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
20' 1 - 0 Goal! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mory Diaw into right side of the goal.
20' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is going to take the penalty!
19' Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
19' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Brest!
18' There's a break in play and referee Marc Bollengier must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Brest using VAR. This could be interesting!
18' Surely that's handball by one of the Clermont players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
16' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Mory Diaw gets down to his right to keep it out.

15' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
15' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
14' Bradley Locko (Brest) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Brest force their opponents to concede a corner.
11' The resulting corner from Yohan Magnin (Clermont) is cleared by the defence.
9' Clermont are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
7' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
7' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
7' Rough tackle by Neto Borges (Clermont). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul.
3' Brest seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' The first half has just begun.
Brest will kick the game off.
Marc Bollengier was nominated as the referee for this game.
